parsed.post: Discarded recent experiment (1.040272) as it regressed from my best (1.035070). It seems MATRIX_LR 0.03 was a sweet spot. Next, I will try adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if stabilization helps at this learning rate and depth.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, AR=48, LR=0.03) to see if training stabilization improves convergence.
